result.summary: The page is largely intact, but an untranslated localization key is prominently visible and some horizontally scrolling content is awkwardly clipped at the right edge.

issues.description: The section heading displays the raw localization key "home_feed.popular_title" instead of a user-facing title.
issues.suggestion: Add or correct the translation entry and render the intended localized heading, such as "Popular near you".

issues.description: The category row and restaurant carousel are cut off at the right viewport edge, leaving a partial category pill and partially visible restaurant card/text that look unintentionally cropped.
issues.suggestion: Verify horizontal carousel behavior and add consistent trailing padding or a clearer scroll affordance so partial items appear intentional.
